subject.title: Feature: Pre-compaction agent notification, structured handoff window, and deferral mechanism

question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-controlled pre-compaction lifecycle contract, and if so should it include warnings only, structured handoff/checkpointing, bounded deferral, or some narrower combination?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses product UX, public config, persistent session state, workspace writes, and authorization boundaries, so implementation should not proceed without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt Warning And Handoff First
options.body: Add an opt-in pre-threshold warning plus structured handoff/checkpoint path while leaving agent-requested deferral out until authority semantics are settled.

options.title: Adopt Full Bounded Deferral
options.body: Implement warning, handoff, and DEFER only with explicit max duration, audit trail, idempotent checkpoint matching, and expiry rules.

options.title: Decline New Lifecycle Surface
options.body: Keep memoryFlush, notifyUser, hooks, and checkpoints as the supported compaction surfaces and route remaining needs to docs or plugins.

recommendation.title: Adopt Warning And Handoff First
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in pre-threshold warning plus structured handoff/checkpoint path while leaving agent-requested deferral out until authority semantics are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is the adjacent memoryFlush feature history, and the remaining decision is product/security direction for the lifecycle contract.
